## 3. Riva di San Pietro — best Marone / northern-east-shore base

**Location:** Via Battista Cristini 5, Marone  
**Official website / booking:** <https://www.rivasanpietro.it/>  
**2026 season:** 9 May–30 September  
**Scale:** 110 pitches

Riva di San Pietro sits directly on the lake and has electricity on all pitches, two pools, restaurant/bar, bicycle rental and pedal-/motor-boat rental. It is a good base if you want to spend more time in the northern half of the lake rather than around Iseo town.
For SUP, **Surface SUP Academy is at Lido Mad Hops, Via Battista Cristini 13**, only a few doors from the campsite at number 5. Its 2026 rental page offers All-Round and faster Superior/Race boards; an All-Round board is **€12.50/1h, €22/2h, €33/3h or €65/day**, plus a €3.50 seasonal Guest membership. This is one of the clearest dedicated-rental setups in the guide.

The campsite itself gives an important access instruction for vehicles: **do not take the Zone/Marone exit from the main road; use the Vello exit instead**.

**2 September booking note:** Exact pitch inventory is not publicly exposed, and I could not verify a clean official 2026 touring-pitch tariff; obtain a direct quote. The third-party budgeting estimate is retained only in the consolidated comparison table above.

**Official site:** <https://www.rivasanpietro.it/?lang=en&page_id=59>

**Best for:** Marone, north-lake exploration, SUP tuition, families wanting a pool.  
**Downside:** no verified on-site SUP rental; shorter season than the Iseo campsites.

---

## 4. Camping Quai — simple, family-run and directly lakeside

**Location:** Via Ippolito Antonioli 73, Iseo  
**Official website / booking:** <https://campingquai.it/>  
**2026 season:** 24 April–11 October

Quai is a separate, family-run lakeside campsite with transparent pricing. For **2 September**, its MID-season rates are **€33 lakefront, €29 second row, €26 XL, €23 central and €20 fourth row**, plus **€12 per adult**, €1 tourist tax per adult and roughly €2–3/day for electricity. The higher July–August MAX rates are €36 / €32 / €29 / €26 / €22 respectively.

Recent camper reviews praise the friendliness, sanitary facilities, restaurant and proximity to Iseo. One useful caveat is that several reviewers describe the actual beach area as limited; the lakefront pitches get the best water views.

Crucially for this trip, Quai **does have its own SUP/kayak rental**. The current official tariff is **€10 for 1 hour, €18 for 2 hours, €25 for 3 hours, €32 for 4 hours or €37 for a full day** for a SUP/single kayak. The campsite recommends reserving the equipment **at least one day in advance at reception**.


**2 September booking note:** Exact availability requires a direct request. Advance bookings normally require three nights (four for lakefront); for shorter stays the campsite explicitly recommends calling the day before to ask about gaps. See the consolidated price table above.

**Booking / price list:** <https://campingquai.it/en/price-list/> · info@campingquai.it · +39 030 9821610

**Best for:** simple lakeside camping near town, people who like small family-run sites, and travellers who want **on-site SUP rental with published prices and advance-reservation guidance**.  
**Downside:** limited beach compared with Camping Iseo/Punta d’Oro; published SUP fleet size is unknown.

---

## 5. Camping Eurovil — strong Predore all-rounder with on-site SUP rental

**Location:** Via San Giorgio 2, Predore  
**Official website / booking:** <https://campingeurovil.it/en/>  
**2026 season:** 27 March–27 September

Eurovil is one of the strongest alternatives outside the Iseo/Pilzone cluster. Its current official campsite page says it has **pitches of different sizes suitable for campers and minivans**, all with **6A electricity**, and that a **new camper area with lake view** opened for the 2026 season. The campsite describes itself as only a few metres from Lake Iseo; its services page is even more useful for this trip because it explicitly lists **SUP rental** and **lake access directly in front of the campsite**. The swimming pools are scheduled to remain open until **13 September 2026**, so they are operating for a 2 September arrival.

The nuance is that this is not quite the same proposition as a Punta d’Oro/Covelo first-row pitch physically touching the water. Eurovil's own wording is “a few metres from the lake” and “lake access in front”; the guide therefore avoids overstating every pitch as literal lakefront.

Rental resilience is nevertheless unusually good. In addition to Eurovil's own SUP service, **Whassup Rental** operates in Predore at Via Roma 3 with online reservations, hourly/full-day rentals and guided/sunset outings. Its current tariff is **€15/1h, €20/1.5h, €25/2h, €40/half-day or €50/full day**, including board, paddle, leash, dry bag and life jacket. That gives Predore a useful second rental channel if the campsite's own boards are busy.

**2 September booking note:** the campsite is open and its booking system is active, but I could not obtain a reliable public touring-pitch tariff or date-specific camper inventory for 2 September. Contact it directly rather than reading mobile-home availability as pitch availability.

**Best for:** renters who want redundancy, medium campers, facilities/pool, a quieter southwestern base near Sarnico/Predore.  
**Downside:** public touring-pitch pricing is less transparent than Pilzone/Olivella; exact SUP fleet size and equipment-reservation rules are not published.
